item.title: Temaribana
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TOPCAT
  • 発売日: 2011-04-28
  • スコア: 6.44/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 手毬花
  • 英語名: Temaribana

别名

  • てまりばな

あらすじ

When Kotora came to, he was on an old-fashioned bus alone heading to Murakumo boarding school. During the long bumpy ride along the mountain roads, he looked outside the window and saw a beautiful yellow-green scenery which warmed his heart. A girl got on the bus and looked at him coldly and asked him if he was a transfer student. He didn’t know why she didn’t like him. The next girl that got on the bus told him not to worry about it since she was always like that.

item.title: Nanapuri.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TOPCAT
  • 発売日: 2010-07-30
  • スコア: 6.7299999999999995/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ななプリ。
  • 英語名: Nanapuri.

别名

  • 7pri

あらすじ

Enor lives by himself in the wilderness of the Gullfoss continent. One day, he came upon a fallen girl by a nearby riverside and took her home to take care of her. Her name is Katarina and she is actually the Seventh Princess Edelweiss’ personal knight. They were pursued by attackers and now the princess is missing, so Katarina asks Enor to pretend to be the princess. So, he dresses up as a girl and goes on a journey together with her.

  • 日本語名: アトリの空と真鍮の月
  • 英語名: Atori no Sora to Shinchuu no Tsuki

あらすじ

There is a school in a small village. One day, Haito, who is back to the village for the first time in six years, transfers to this school, but there are only four female students. According to them, people in the village believe in some kind of god. As he lives there, he gradually finds a secret the villagers try to hide…

item.title: Hateshinaku Aoi, Kono Sora no Shita de...

  • 英語名: Hateshinaku Aoi, Kono Sora no Shita de…

别名

  • Hateao

あらすじ

“Our school will be closed down next year.” I know that…. There are only six students (I’m one and only male student…!) A train station will be constructed here. Anyway, what should I do until the school is closed…? We’ll get separated next year…. As I look up the sky, the blue sky is spreading as if lapping me over. What am I doing next year…?

item.title: L
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TOPCAT
  • 発売日: 1999-09-03
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: L-エル-
  • 英語名: L

别名

  • 「Ｌ」－エル－

あらすじ

“I’ve just successfully graduated, and my student life ends today…”

The protagonist looks back on his four years of student life, busy with classes, club activities, part-time jobs, and many other things.

“…I realized that I actually didn’t know much about the city and the people who lived there.”

Until his new life begins, he takes a short two-week break and starts walking around town, taking in sights both familiar and unfamiliar.
